title: Rental cars
subtitle: Every rental with its station, period and car.

deleteError: The rental could not be deleted.

list.emptyHint: Add your first rental or read in a booking mail.

station.searchPlaceholder: Search an airport or an earlier station
station.searchError: The station search is not answering. Try again or enter an address.
station.noHits: No station found. Enter an address instead.

form.stationClockHint: Times are in each station's local time, as the booking prints them.
form.distanceHint: Kilometres driven come from the final invoice, else from the two odometer readings (return minus pick-up). A value under "correction" overrides both and is shown as a correction by hand.
form.saveError: The rental could not be saved.

errors.stationUnplaced: Please pick a station or enter an address.
errors.timeRequired: Please enter a date and time.
errors.acriss: An ACRISS code has four letters.
errors.stationUnresolved: This station cannot be placed. Pick an airport or enter an address.
errors.geocoderUnavailable: The address search is not answering. The rental was not saved – try again in a moment.
errors.returnBeforePickup: The return is before the pickup.
errors.odometerReversed: The odometer at return cannot be below the one at pick-up.
errors.invalid: A value was not accepted. Please check the form.
errors.nonexistentTime: This time does not exist at the station (clock change).
errors.unknownBooking: There is no rental with this booking number.
errors.timeShape: Please enter a full date and time – or choose "date only".
errors.actualReturnBeforePickup: The actual return is before the actual pickup.
errors.depositReturnExceeds: More cannot come back than was held.
errors.depositReturnedBeforePaid: The deposit cannot have come back before it was held.

form.notesHint: Your own notes – they also appear on the return card.
form.invoiceHint: A final amount you change here is saved as a correction by hand; an amount from an imported invoice otherwise stays as it is.

steps.label: Rental steps
steps.pickupIntro: What happened at the counter – all optional. The booked times are under "Booking".

form.depositHint: A deposit is money held, not spent – it never counts as a cost. A currency other than the price's is stored as it is; nothing is converted.
form.depositReturnedHint: Less than was held is a partial refund; the rest stays visible as outstanding.

detail.loadError: The rental could not be loaded.
detail.oneWayNote: One-way rental · only a roadtrip knows the route driven.
detail.mapSame: Returned where picked up: one point.
detail.mapOneWay: One-way rental: the dashed line joins pickup and return – it is not the route driven.
detail.mapRoadtrip: The linked roadtrip shows the route driven.
detail.differenceCurrencies: different currencies – no difference computed, nothing converted

costCounts.final: The cost counted is the final amount – once, not on top of the booked price.
costCounts.booked: The cost counted is the booked price until an invoice arrives.
costCounts.cancellationFee: Only the cancellation fee counts as a cost.
costCounts.none: No amount known yet – the rental is in no cost total.

import.panelHint: Do you have a booking confirmation or an invoice? Read it in.

action.invoice: Add the invoice to the rental

import.updateNote: This booking number exists already. The rental is completed; what you changed by hand stays.
import.unknownBooking: There is no rental with booking number {{number}}. A cancellation or invoice creates none – read the booking confirmation first.
import.ambiguous: “{{name}}” fits several airports. Pick the right one:
import.geocoded: "{{name}}" is not an airport in the catalogue. The address search suggests {{place}} – check the place before you save.
import.geocoderUnavailable: The address search cannot be reached right now, so "{{name}}" could not be placed. Pick the station yourself.
import.stationUnplaced: Please pick the station – nothing is saved without a place.
import.kmConflict: The invoice says {{km}} km; you entered another figure by hand. Should the invoice's figure count?

empty.parking: This is a parking booking, not a rental car.
empty.noItinerary: This mail from the provider holds no booking.
empty.noTemplate: TravStats cannot read this rental document yet. Enter the rental by hand.
empty.notConfirmed: The rental is on request only, not confirmed yet.
empty.otherDomain: This document is not a rental booking.
empty.generic: No rental was found in this document.

import.stale: This mail is older than the last one read for this booking. Nothing was overwritten – the newer mail stands.
import.cancellationFee: Cancellation fee: {{amount}} – it is stored as the cost of this cancelled rental.

suggest.roadtrip: Fits the roadtrip “{{name}}”. Was this rental its car?
suggest.stationOffer: Linked. You can take pickup “{{first}}” and return “{{last}}” as the roadtrip's first and last station.
suggest.failed: The suggestions could not be loaded or applied.

stats.brokerNote: Brokers do not count as providers; they are shown on the rental.
stats.countriesNote: Pickup and return only, no countries driven through.
stats.loadError: The rental statistics could not be loaded.
stats.cancellationFees_one: Cancellation fees: {{list}} for {{count}} cancelled rental – not in the cost per day.
stats.cancellationFees_other: Cancellation fees: {{list}} for {{count}} cancelled rentals – not in the cost per day.

invoiceMissing: The invoice is still missing: it supplies the kilometres driven. Read it in once you have it.

invoiceReview.loadFailed: The rental for this invoice could not be loaded – the comparison is missing.
invoiceReview.feesNote: TravStats does not read single fees out of invoices yet; the difference is their sum. The booked price is kept either way.
